public.clients_secure.definition: SELECT id, business_id, name, phone, email, notes, tags, telegram_id, birthday, total_visits, total_spent, last_visit_at, created_at, viber_user_id, whatsapp_number, phone_encrypted, email_encrypted, whatsapp_encrypted, decrypt_pii(phone_encrypted) AS phone_secure, decrypt_pii(email_encrypted) AS email_secure, decrypt_pii(whatsapp_encrypted) AS whatsapp_secure FROM clients
public.clients_secure.name: clients_secure

public.client_stats.definition: SELECT c.id AS client_id, c.business_id, count(t.id)::integer AS total_visits, COALESCE(sum(t.amount), 0::numeric)::numeric(10,2) AS total_spent, max(t.created_at) AS last_visit_at FROM clients c LEFT JOIN transactions t ON t.client_id = c.id AND t.status = 'completed'::text GROUP BY c.id, c.business_id
public.client_stats.name: client_stats
